message: 新たな旅路へと

name: Misasagi
message: 「Good day to you, President」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Misasagi-senpai. Hello」
Fancy seeing her in a place like this.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Are you heading out somewhere?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, I was planning to, but... could it be that you have some business with me?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my, how perceptive of you. That certainly saves me the trouble」

name: Synn
message: 「No, well, it just seemed like you were a bit less energetic than usual」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Me?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「...Is that so. If even someone as easygoing as you can tell, then there's no point in beating around the bush」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, um, I'm sorry」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now don't make a face like that. I'm complimenting you, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, no, I haven't done anything worth complimenting...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee. You really are such a delightful person, President」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Just chatting with you like this puts my heart at ease」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-thank you」
Somehow, it felt like Misasagi-senpai's expression softened just a little.

name: Synn
message: 「So, what kind of matter did you want to discuss?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Yes. Truth be told, I have a favor to ask of you, President, since I know I can count on you」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I would like you to shelter me at your house for a little while」

name: Synn
message: 「Go right ahead」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Much obliged」

name: Synn
message: 「So, um... could you tell me the details?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Of course, I'll tell you everything」
Misasagi-senpai lightly moistens her lips with tea before turning to face me.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Right now, I am... in the middle of running away」

name: Synn
message: 「Run away? Are you being chased by someone!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well... if you put it that way, I suppose I might be」

name: Synn
message: 「That's terrible! We have to notify the police right away!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「There's no need for that. I didn't mean it in that sense, you see」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean by that?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「From here on, this becomes a personal story about myself, though... would you mind indulging me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course. Anything I can do to help」

name: Misasagi
message: 「As always... you truly are a kind person, President」
Misasagi-senpai's cheeks soften gently.
So she can smile like this too, huh.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now then, to get to the main point... you were already aware that my future path has been decided for me, yes?」
I'd heard rumors about it before. That the young lady of the Misasagi zaibatsu already has a fiance.

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. Um... you have a betrothed, right」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You may call it a political marriage if you like, I don't mind」

name: Misasagi
message: 「After all, ever since I was little, I've been made to walk down the tracks my parents laid out for me, whether I liked it or not」
It was a story I'd heard a little bit about before.
Though the customs of wealthy families are so distant from my own life that it doesn't feel very real to me.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Still, living one's entire life at the beck and call of one's parents sounds rather empty, wouldn't you agree?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, certainly... though I can't really imagine it well」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee, how honest of you」

name: Misasagi
message: 「And so, being human myself, I made a selfish request to my parents and had them grant me just one promise」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Namely, that as long as I remain a student, they would allow me to do as I please」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that... how it was...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Mind you, that promise is only valid within the bounds of Ryuusei Town, where my parents can still keep an eye on me...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「And more than anything, that student life of mine is coming to an end very soon」
I see...
Right after Senpai graduates from the academy, she's going to be married off to her fiance.
Once that happens, she won't be able to choose her own path anymore, nor will she have the freedom she's had up until now.

name: Misasagi
message: 「When I think about how my chances to travel freely and my dreams of seeing more of the wider world are going to be snatched out of my reach, it hurts so much I can't bear it」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, even up till now, it's questionable whether the path I walked was truly one I chose for myself, though」
Does that mean in the end, I have to go back onto the rails someone else laid out for me…….

name: Synn
message: 「Um, Senpai, I……」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my, President, you're looking terribly gloomy. Aren't you taking this a bit too much to heart?」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, ah, I'm sorry. As the one you're confiding in, I shouldn't be acting like this……」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Not at all. There's nothing wrong with that in the slightest」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Just having you listen to me so sympathetically like this lifts my spirits」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It made ditching tea with my fiance well worth it」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, is that really okay……」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Having reality thrust right in front of my eyes started making me feel rather sick, you see」

name: Misasagi
message: 「On top of that, I felt restless and anxious…… I just couldn't stand it anymore without opening up to someone about how I feel」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Still, I couldn't possibly unload such rambling complaints onto Ria……」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Why is that?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, of course... at first, I was counting on Ria.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「However, Ria's position isn't all that different from my own.」
Even if her marriage hasn't been decided yet, being a young lady from a good family probably puts her in much the same boat.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ria has her own future to think about, after all.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I simply cannot be any more selfish and trouble my dearest friend.」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's why you haven't gone to Ria-senpai for help.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Yes. I do not wish to cause her any unnecessary worry.」
She cares so much for her friend that she's willing to accept her own fate like that.
You're one to talk, Senpai--you're way too kind yourself.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Besides, if I were at Ria's estate, my hiding place would be discovered right away.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「If the path ahead of me is already decided anyway, I thought I might as well take a detour for as long as I can.」
Ria-senpai does seem like the type who's terrible at keeping secrets, after all.

name: Misasagi
message: 「And so, well, that is how I came to look for someone else I might rely on」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Even I, you know, am still at an age where I want to act selfishly, wouldn't you say?」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai...」
I had always thought she was way more mature than someone like me, yet seeing her like this makes me feel like Senpai is just a normal girl for her age too.
Someone I thought lived in a completely different world from me suddenly feels so close.
Thinking that isn't rude of me, right...

name: Misasagi
message: 「...Mr. President?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes, what is it!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Fufu. I was just wondering what might be the matter, seeing you suddenly staring so intently at my chest」

name: Synn
message: 「Eeeh!? I-I-I wasn't staring at it or anything!」
Though I definitely did think she was mature in that way.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Then are you saying you were just stealing little glances at it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's only because I was worried about you, Misasagi-senpai, it's not like I was specifically interested in just your chest--aah...」
A slip of the tongue. Digging my own grave.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee. It truly is so entertaining being with you, Mr. President」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, uh, thank you very much, I'm honored...」
Still, I started wondering if there wasn't something I could do for Senpai...
And because I wanted to do something for her...
So really, that couldn't be helped.

name: Synn
message: 「Um, Senpai」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Yes. Whatever is the matter, sounding so formal?」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, you still don't want to go back home for a while, right?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Indeed. Given that I brought this up by asking you to shelter me, there is no mistake about that」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Truth be told, I would love nothing more than to travel much farther away, to all sorts of different places, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, since we're already taking a detour, would you like to go somewhere else?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Somewhere else?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. Because I have other friends we can consult with!」

name: Misa
message: 「I see. I understand the situation」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In other words, we just need to derail Misasagi-san from her tracks, right!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not exactly thrilled about helping out Bubuzuke, though」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone... thank you」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I wondered where you were taking me... so you're saying we're borrowing the Student Council's wisdom, then」

name: Synn
message: 「Was that a bad idea after all?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Not at all, nothing of the sort. It's very much like you, President」
Hearing Senpai say that is reassuring.

name: Ria
message: 「Ayanishiki-chan, um...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, looks like I ended up dragging Ria into this too」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, I can give good advice too, you know...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Forgive me, Ria. It's not that I wasn't counting on you」

name: Ria
message: 「No, don't worry about it. I understand how you feel, Ayanishiki-chan」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ria... thank you kindly」
These two really are close.
Even if they end up far apart, this bond between them will surely never fade.

name: Misa
message: 「So, Sakura-kun. Do you actually have any concrete ideas in mind?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhh... for starters, I was thinking it'd be nice if we could go on a trip somewhere far away」

name: Misa
message: 「What is that? That's no different from not thinking at all!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Straying from the path--so-called heresy! What sort of evil deeds should we get our hands dirty with?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, you're the one who's derailing here, Roro-chan」

name: Ria
message: 「If we're going on a trip far away, I definitely think a boat or a train would be best」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Then if we get tickets and pack our bags, it's a flawless plan!」

name: Misa
message: 「What part of that is flawless?! That's not even a plan in the first place!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I wouldn't mind that at all. An aimless journey has its own charm, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmph! I couldn't care less what happens, as long as Bubuzuke gets out of my hair」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You say that, even though you're actually going to miss me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As if I ever would!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Is that so? Well, I'll certainly be lonely」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urgh... h-hey, cut it out, you're throwing me off my rhythm! Just hurry up and scram already!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, you're not very convincing when you're so flustered」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up! If it hadn't been Synn asking, I never would've even listened to you!」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, pushing yourself like that...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, how exactly does one go about becoming a delinquent?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't even know how to buy tickets or anything...」

name: Riesling
message: 「If that is the case, please take these」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sebastian!」

name: Riesling
message: 「They are unlimited cruising passes, valid anywhere in the world」

name: Riesling
message: 「A ship departs from the harbor at Seaside Park, so please make use of them」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much, Riesling-san」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then let us commence our delinquency at once!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「If anything, this is more like eloping, isn't it」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Right now?」

name: Ria
message: 「I mean, they do say strike while the iron is hot, but...」

name: Misa
message: 「Shouldn't you at least decide on a destination first? What about your luggage...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's no matter. You can travel just fine empty-handed, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「If Misasagi-senpai says so, I guess it's fine」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then, with that settled, shall we be off?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Me?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Of course. A journey always needs a companion, after all.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「More importantly, just who was it that invited me out like this, I wonder?」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh... Well, I did say I'd keep you company if there was anything I could do, but...」
Still, sending Senpai off all by herself now would be irresponsible.

name: Misa
message: 「If that's what you're worried about, you're fine. There's no problem at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Misa
message: 「While Sakura-kun is away, I'll serve as acting Student Council President.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Wait, is that really okay?」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm more capable than you anyway, so it's fine.」

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka-chan and I will keep an eye on the Wagashi Club.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, don't just decide that on your own!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, I'll team up with Jeeves to run a cover-up and erase all traces of you and the President!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll pass on that service, thanks.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now then, Mr. President. Are you all prepared?」

name: Synn
message: 「If I'll do, then I'll gladly accompany you!」
Now that we've come this far, I can't just leave her on her own.
Let's set off on a journey in search of Misae-senpai's freedom!

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then it's settled! Now everyone, let's see the President and his companion off!」

name: Misa
message: 「With this, the President's seat will finally be mine♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gasp!? Bubuzuke is one thing, but Synn can't disappear too!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I firmly obj--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Kyuu」

name: Riesling
message: 「Lady Nanaka, please stay asleep for a little while.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ayane, we might not be able to see each other for a while, so take care, okay?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You stay strong too, Lia.」
Is nobody going to say a word of farewell to me?

name: Misasagi
message: 「Shall we get going, Prez?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Helena, is it not safe for you to come out now?」

name: Helena
message: 「Phew. Those kids finally left.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Are you sure this was for the best?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, it looks like you handed over the passes without a hitch. Thank you.」

name: Riesling
message: 「That is not what I meant--I am asking whether it was wise to let them go...」

name: Helena
message: 「A little adventure like that is something I'll gladly authorize using my powers as chairwoman.」

name: Helena
message: 「Besides, I intend to meet her parents in person and explain the situation to them.」

name: Riesling
message: 「You seem rather partial to them.」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, when my students are out there searching for their own future, I can't just leave them hanging, can I? ♪」

name: Riesling
message: 「Is that how it works?」

name: Helena
message: 「Besides, what they're doing is still pretty tame.」

name: Helena
message: 「A youthful indiscretion, you could say? Back in the day, we used to tear things up ourselves!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Well, I have no recollection of that.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, come on, don't be such a tease, Tamiko.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh well. Anyway, here's hoping those kids have a wonderful journey.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misasagi-senpai. It looks like it's almost time to depart.」
I step up beside Senpai, who had been gazing out at the sea from the deck.

name: Synn
message: 「Are you nervous after all?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Does it look that way to you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm not feeling uneasy at all, you know」

name: Misasagi
message: 「After all, I have a reliable President right here beside me」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Come on... You're making me blush」

name: Misasagi
message: 「What about you, President? You're sure you don't have any regrets?」

name: Synn
message: 「No way! As long as I'm with you, Misasagi-senpai, I'll be just fine」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone saw us off with their blessings, and besides, I figure if it's you, Senpai, it'll be okay even if I ask for one more selfish wish」

name: Misasagi
message: 「President...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee. Trying too hard to sound cool really doesn't suit you, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, no, I wasn't trying to...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Still, truly, I'm really glad I talked to you, President」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'll be in your care from here on out」
The ship carrying Misasagi-senpai and me slowly begins to move.
From here on out, our journey--with no telling how far it will go--begins.
